cohort: 60 women admitted with ruptured ectopic pregnancy to the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Siddhartha Government Medical College, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India, between March 2021 and February 2022.
finding: Ruptured ectopic pregnancy was most common in women aged 20-30 years (66.6%), from low socioeconomic backgrounds (83.3%), and with a history of previous cesarean section (53.4%); the most common presenting symptoms were abdominal pain (78.4%) and pain with vaginal bleeding (13.4%); and the most common treatment was exploratory laparotomy with salpingectomy (95.1%).
